'''Sarria Jevad''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was stationed at the command center in [[Drift Hills Imperial Outpost]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. An Imperial Scout Captain, she and the scout [[Davi]] were concerned with the Republic trying to turn a downed starfighter into a powerful offensive snowspeeder. When Davi did not reply to a comm check in time, Sarria recruited an Imperial hero acting in the name of the [[Bane Brigade]] to complete the mission and blow up the remains of the starfighter.
